units.source_text: 薰君如此尊敬八亲王，冷泉院也就常常遣使致书问候。

en.t: Because Kaoru showed such respect for the Eighth Prince, Reizei-in also often sent messengers with letters of greeting.

units.source_text: 八亲王在世间多年来默默无闻，其宫邸一向门庭寂寂，此时就常常有人出入了。

en.t: For many years the Eighth Prince had lived unnoticed by the world, and his residence had always been quiet and deserted, but now people often came and went there.

units.source_text: 每逢季节，冷泉院馈赠极丰。

en.t: At each change of season, Reizei-in sent especially generous gifts.

units.source_text: 薰君也每逢机会，必表敬意，有时奉赠玩赏之具，有时致送实用物品。

en.t: Kaoru too showed his respect whenever he had the chance, sometimes presenting objects for pleasure and sometimes sending practical things.

units.source_text: 如此交往，至今已有三年了。

en.t: This exchange had continued in this way for three years now.
